description.zh-CN: 把商品放进贴合用途的生活或使用场景；保留原商品像素。
description.en: Places the product in a lifestyle or usage scene that fits it; keeps the original product pixels.

prompt.prefix: commercial photography of a realistic scene, the subject resting naturally on the surface with soft contact shadows and reflections,
prompt.suffix: photorealistic lighting that matches the scene, shallow depth of field
prompt.negative: text, watermark, product, bottle, jar, tube, box, packaging, container, cluttered composition
